|game_text=Deploy on table. Character here lost if new character arrives. Your Force generation is +2 while Bespin: Cloud City on table. During owner’s control phase, they must relocate character here to a Cloud City site (if a bounty hunter on Cloud City, character captured instead). (Immune to Alter.)

|notes=The set was released 21 November 2003. The complete first sheet remains unlocated. The comparison dates each surviving issuer text. [https://web.archive.org/web/20031202154611id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm Players Committee release announcement]. The Dark remaster specifies Bespin: Cloud City for the same generation bonus. It removes the placement-triggered 1-Force loss and uses the new-arrival loss rule for occupancy. The capture alternative under a Cloud City bounty hunter appears on both 2004 slips and the remaster.  The Dark card displays the matching collector 49 slip. The previously associated collector 22 slip belongs to the independent Light design. [[:File:VS6O-22-Weather_Vane.png|retained image file]].
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154341/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards6.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards6.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #32 on 14 September 2007); page 4, slip 49. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Weather Vane (Dark)]].
